verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia offers organizations where owners/admins can invite users and share collections/environments (kong-docs-37, kong-docs-41), giving some collaboration control, but this is account-level invite management, not granular role-based permissions distinguishing view vs edit access on APIs/collections. No evidence of RBAC (role definitions, permission scopes, viewer/editor roles) for API gateway entities or Insomnia workspaces. missing for 10: explicit role/permission system (viewer/editor/admin roles), granular access control documentation for APIs or collections, evidence of enforcement (e.g., a user blocked from editing), and any platform-engineer-facing RBAC configuration docs.
